C0912.title: Guangdong Huika Payment Institution Facilitated Cross-Border Gambling Money Laundering of RMB 4.3 Billion
C0912.summary: In March 2022, a court in Yichang, Hubei Province convicted executives of third-party payment company Guangdong Huika, including Vice President Liu, for building an illegal fourth-party payment platform that provided fund channels for overseas gambling syndicates, handling illicit receipts and payments totaling RMB 4.314 billion. Principal offenders Zhang, Bai, and Yin received prison sentences of

references.title: Fourteen people, including a deputy general manager of a payment institution, sentenced for laundering 4.3 billion yuan for cross-border gambling
